purpose: Synthetic prior authorization criteria guides for testing DocIntel healthcare agentic workflows. These are not payer contracts and must be replaced or overridden by real payer/plan policy documents before production use.

guides.title: Sample Payer Policy Guide - MRI Lumbar Spine Prior Authorization
Sample Payer Policy Guide - GLP-1 Medication Prior Authorization
Sample Payer Policy Guide - Physical Therapy Prior Authorization

selection_guidance.mvp: Use the closest synthetic guide by service category when no real payer policy is uploaded.
selection_guidance.production: Prefer exact payer, plan, state, benefit, service, date-effective policy, and delegated vendor criteria over synthetic baseline guides.
selection_guidance.fallback: If payer-specific criteria are missing, mark the prior authorization packet as needs_review and list missing payer policy evidence.
